quality_proxy.method: diagonal activation-aware relative expected local projection output error
quality_proxy.activation_capture: unchanged BF16 source model, hooks at each original 28x7 projection input, aggregate per-input-channel sample second moment of BF16 full-model hidden inputs
quality_proxy.score: for each tensor i: sum_j E_cal[a_j^2] * sum_r (W4_ij - W_ij)^2 divided by sum_j E_cal[a_j^2] * sum_r W_ij^2 minus same ratio for 8bit
quality_proxy.layer_limit: This is diagonal covariance approximation; no cross-channel covariance, no downstream Hessian, no causal full-vocab output intervention
quality_proxy.scope: public calibration prompts only; no old V6, no prior private label/C1-D eval

kernel_and_concurrency.hardware: Apple Mac13,1 BEGLIN CPU native Q4G64 fused 6-thread vs qNg64-n8 repacked NEON 1-thread
kernel_and_concurrency.execution: n8 & q4 kernels are never assumed concurrent by default; explicitly benchmark Q/K/V parallel vs serial on same CPU
kernel_and_concurrency.graph: pre-norm -> concurrent q/k/v candidate stage -> attention -> o -> norm -> concurrent gate/up candidate stage -> down -> next decoder layer; synchronization joins at dependency boundaries
kernel_and_concurrency.resource_limits: Bound CPU worker thread count by actual hardware; shared native Q4 pool calls cannot be concurrent without independent pools; model is serial unless measured overlap advantage
kernel_and_concurrency.objective: source activation-aware quantization penalty minimized under exact 28 n8, <=830570496 projection bytes, estimated 100ms single-token and observed concurrency feasibility
kernel_and_concurrency.control_policies: old source-weight-only kernel-aware, prior role-balanced random, allQ4 and allN8

failure_condition: missing activation stats, bad checkpoint SHA, invalid replica tensor ordering, changing heldout windows or unavailable real async timing => no policy promotion
